$comment: Walking-skeleton ruleset for the vertical slice (member → membership → event registration). Targets mirror benchmarks-draft.json v0.9.2 (canonical — that file wins). Effect sizes use the ruleset-spec §2 bands: weak 0.15-0.40, med 0.40-0.90, strong 0.90-1.80 per 1 SD. ASSUMPTION markers = provisional pending reconciliation/workshop. CORE MODULE: the shared substrate every domain module builds on.

scale.$note: THE demo scope (D-register): a bare build produces the canonical 2,500-member world. Tests pass --n 500 explicitly for speed — explicit beats implicit for the small world, not the shipped one.

engagementDrift.$note: 2026-07-10: engagement is a sticky-but-drifting PROCESS, not a lifetime constant. Each person's yearly theta = stable anchor (anchorShare of the variance; copula-correlated with affluence) + a persistent AR(1) wander (the rest). Members rise and fade over the decade; the faders are who lapses — which is what makes Sonar trends and churn early-warning real for the crowd, not just for pinned heroes. Total variance stays 1 so all beta effect sizes keep their meaning.

cohorts.$assumption: D6 pending ratification: calendar-year dominant + anniversary minority (auto-pay bills on join anniversary + grandfathered)

regimes.$note: era shifts are TIDE, not boats — applied to the calibrated baseline, never inside the calibrated scores (the 2026-07-10 lesson: a shared shift inside calibration gets solved away). Data-driven so scenarios can override them and future eras (recession, membership drive) are one entry, not a code change.

yearlyLogitWobble.$note: co-designed with effect sizes AND tolerances (spec §3): sigma raised 0.08→0.13 when the compiled +12pt auto-renew effect pushed members toward the renewal ceiling, where the sigmoid compresses wobble (the variance-floor gate caught it); rho lowered 0.5→0.3 so the multi-year MEAN still averages onto target. At pilot scale binomial cohort noise adds ~2pt on top; re-tune at production scale

statusMix.$note: Active/Lapsed/Cancelled/PendingRenewal at release; loose check at N=500
